permits.description: one unit-interior remodel of existing condominium; remodel kitchen; remodel existing bathroom and closet to create separate powder room; modify closet for installation of washer/dryer; new lighting throughout; new tankless water heater; replace windows and skylights in existing openings.

repair dryrot in roof substraight approx 100 sq ft. apply new water proofing over roor dick approx 2100 sq ft. repair dry rot siding in court yard and overlay with cedar shingles. not visible from street. repair in kind

work @ one unit only. remodel kitchen & bathroom & 1/2 bath. replace cabinets, counters, fixtures, tile, flooring. no structural changes. 50% of wattage of kitchen lighting to be fluorescant bathroom lighting to be fluorescant or on occupant sensor.
work on 2nd floor, one unit - removing closet in master bedroom. relocating pony wall and installing glass block to height of rail along interior stairs. non-structural work.
install 12 replacement windows & 2 replacement skylites. not visible from street. u value .38 - .52. same for same.
remove existing sheetmetal cap, wood siding
